ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Quiet New Factions
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Stops Vanilla Expanded Framework's "new faction" window from coming back on every load.
When a save lacks a faction that an active mod provides, VEF opens a window for it at each load. Its "skip" button records nothing, so the window returns next time; only "ignore" is remembered, in the save. This mod answers "ignore" for you, for every faction the window would show.
A faction that its mod marks as required is left alone: VEF's own window still opens for it, since that window refuses both skip and ignore for such a faction.
Each ignored faction is written to the log: "[Quiet New Factions] defName (mod) ignored in this save."
To add a faction to an existing save after all, remove this mod for one load, or use VEF's own tools.
The choice is stored by VEF in the save, not by this mod: removing this mod later changes nothing for factions already ignored.
